ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Financial Transaction Reports Act (Act No. 7398, as amended, with Presidential Decree No. 33375); Act on Regulation and Punishment of Criminal Proceeds Concealment (Act No. 17480); Commercial Act, Chapter VII (Articles 553-600) regulating Yuhan Hoesa; Act on Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets (Act No. 8635) for licensed-entity triggers; Korea Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU) reporting and enforcement standards under the Financial Services Commission.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner (foreign corporate shareholder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry or commercial court of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If the originating country is a Hague Apostille Convention member: notarize the certificate or certified copy, then obtain a Hague Apostille from the originating country's competent authority. If the originating country is not a Convention member: notarize, then process consular legalization at the Korean Embassy or Consulate having jurisdiction and authentication by the Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The two authentication mechanisms are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain Apostille and Consular Legalization sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the ultimate corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry or revenue authority of the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Same mutually exclusive rule: use Hague Apostille only for Apostille Convention states and Consular Legalization only for non-Convention states; do not add both. The certificate must be issued within 90 days before filing, and the signature of the issuing officer must be notarized.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution (or sole shareholder resolution) authorizing formation of the Korean Yuhan Hoesa and appointing an irrevocable Power of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors / corporate secretary of the foreign parent entity, attested by a local notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the resolution and power of attorney in the foreign parent's home state, then apply for Hague Apostille (if Apostille state) or Korean Consular Legalization (if non-Apostille state). The two paths remain mutually exclusive; include a certified English/Korean translation for filing with the Korean registry and banks.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Articles of Association of the Yuhan Hoesa (draft incorporation constating document)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Korean notary public under the Notaries Act, after drafting by a licensed Korean attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: This is a domestic Korean instrument; no foreign Apostille or Consular Legalization is required. Foreign shareholder signatures appearing in the articles must be certified through the applicable foreign authentication path already described; attach a sworn translation certificate for all non-Korean text.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and source-of-funds confirmation for each shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank holding the shareholder's account in the shareholder's home state
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The bank officer's signature must be notarized, and the letter must be authenticated either by Hague Apostille (Apostille state) or Consular Legalization at the Korean consulate (non-Apostille state). The bank letter must not be older than 30 days at the time of Korean bank account opening; Apostille and Consular Legalization are parallel alternatives and must never be combined.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All beneficial owners, directors and authorized signatories must be screened against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, and the Korean Ministry of Foreign Affairs Designated Individuals and Entities List. PEP identification must follow KoFIU guidance under the Financial Transaction Reports Act; senior foreign PEPs, domestic high-ranking officials and close associates require enhanced due diligence, documented source of wealth, senior management approval and ongoing transaction monitoring. Adverse-media and negative-news searches must be refreshed within 24 hours before each filing; any hit is escalated to the AML compliance officer and suspends formation until clearance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Supreme Court of Korea Internet Registration Office (IRO; also known as the Court Registry Business Processing System) operated by the District Court Registration Division of the local court of the proposed registered address
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name must be entered in Korean script (Hangul). The corporate name of a limited liability company must contain the exact statutory suffix 'Yuhan Hoesa'; foreign-language trade names are permitted only through a phonetic Hangul transliteration. The four-tier naming convention is: (1) distinctive element, (2) business-purpose or transliterated element, (3) optional geographic qualifier, and (4) mandatory liability form 'Yuhan Hoesa'. English-only names are not accepted in the official register; a parallel English trade name may be declared for banking and documentary purposes only.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 180 days and cannot be administratively extended; applicants must file a new reservation if the validity period lapses. Upon rejection, the applicant or its Korean attorney may file a written objection with the head of the District Court Registration Division within 14 days of the rejection notice, identifying the statutory objection basis and attaching the rejected name-search receipt. If the registry judge confirms the rejection, the applicant may appeal to the competent administrative court under the Administrative Litigation Act within 60 days of the confirmation date. Legal counsel should, in parallel, file a fresh name reservation with a materially distinct name to preserve the formation timetable.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox address is not per se rejected for ISIC 5229 rail-freight forwarding, but the National Tax Service, the local registry court and Korean commercial banks will reject a pure mailbox address for VAT/business registration and corporate current-account opening. The company must maintain a measurable commercial substance location: a serviced office with a dedicated private room, a physical lease contract concluded with the office provider, and the capacity to receive tax notices, customs documents, cargo bills and on-site inspections. For letter-of-credit settlement transactions, banks require the corporate address to appear on invoices and bills of lading, so a registered virtual address alone is operationally inadequate.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 28 percent probability of an unannounced National Tax Service (NTS) field inspection within the first 12 months after VAT registration for newly formed freight forwarding companies that use serviced offices; the court registry inspection risk is approximately 5 percent. Inspection checklist: physical signage in Korean matching the registry name, current lease and utility contracts in the entity's name, employee payroll and four-insurance filings, local representative or employee at the address, server or office equipment for rail freight operations, and correct hard-copy business registration and corporate register extracts. Missing items may trigger deemed non-substance and retroactive denial of tax benefits.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff for incorporation documents, minimum notary fee benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization of foreign UBO corporate documents, board resolution and powers of attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority of the foreign state, or Korean Embassy/Consulate and Ministry of Foreign Affairs for non-Apostille states
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Sovereign fee schedule per document page plus courier; market benchmark USD 80-120 per page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Korean-English translation of all incorporation and UBO documents, including translator's sworn oath
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed sworn translation firm or notarized translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing translation market rate USD 0.12-0.20 per source word with minimum per-document charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Korean law firm fee for pre-incorporation due diligence, name clearance, drafting Articles, and registration coordination

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Serviced office operator in the chosen Korean city

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank service tariff for account setup and third-party compliance consultant fee for UBO and PEP documentation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea, particularly Articles 288 through 317 (general incorporation), Articles 553 through 589 (Yuhan Hoesa limited liability company), and Article 100 (registration of juristic persons), together with the Framework Act on National Taxes and the Foreign Investment Promotion Act for non-resident shareholders.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Civil Registry Division of the Local District Court where the principal office is located, acting under the authority of the Supreme Court of Korea on-line registration system for juristic persons.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation and Certificate of Paid-in Capital Subscription together with the Instrument for Registration of Incorporation of a Limited Liability Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-in capital is required for a Yuhan Hoesa. The full subscribed capital must nevertheless be physically deposited into a temporary escrow bank account opened in the company's name or in an incorporator's verified escrow account before filing. A Certificate of Capital Deposit issued by the bank, bearing the branch manager's seal, must accompany the registration application. A practical initial capital of KRW 10,000,000 is recommended to facilitate opening business bank accounts and executing rail-freight agency contracts. For non-resident shareholders, the capital remittance must be reported under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act before corporate bank accounts are activated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLVED at a duly convened first board of directors meeting of YUHANGHOESA (Limited Liability Company), a South Korean legal entity, held on [date] at the company's registered office, at which a quorum of all directors was present or executed a unanimous written consent waiving notice, and acting pursuant to the Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea and the company's notarized Articles of Incorporation. The meeting adopted the following resolutions.

1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND CONFIRMATION. The Board reviewed the Certificate of Capital Deposit issued by [Bank Name] on [date] stating that the incorporators have paid in full the subscribed membership capital of KRW 10,000,000 into the temporary escrow account of the company, and the Board hereby ratifies and confirms the subscription of 100 membership interests, each with a par value of KRW 100,000, held by the subscribers named in the Articles of Incorporation. The chairman is directed to record the capital contribution in the company's capital register and to cause the capital to be utilized only for lawful corporate purposes after the date of registration.

2. BANKING AND TRADE FINANCE AUTHORIZATION. The Board authorizes the Representative Director to open, operate, close, and maintain all bank accounts in the name of the company, including demand deposit accounts, foreign-currency accounts, SWIFT wire receipt accounts, and letter-of-credit accounts. Any two officers, comprising the Representative Director, the Finance Director, and the Corporate Secretary, acting jointly, are empowered to sign banking instruments, with a standing joint-signature limit of KRW 500,000,000, and the Representative Director alone may execute daily operational transactions not exceeding KRW 50,000,000. All banking resolutions are effective immediately.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. The Board adopts as the company's registered office the place specified in the Articles and in the finalized lease at [street address], Republic of Korea. The Representative Director is authorized to execute the lease agreement, deposit and surety instruments, utility contracts, registered-agent appointments, and all notices required to be filed with the District Court Registry and local tax authorities.

4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS. The Board appoints [Name] as Representative Director, [Name] as Finance Director, and [Name] as Corporate Secretary and Auditor, each to serve until the second ordinary general meeting and until successors are lawfully appointed. Each officer accepts office and is vested with authority to execute documents, enforce governance, represent the company before courts, banks, government agencies, and railway counterparties, and to ensure filing of all statutory reports.

5. RATIFICATION AND IMPLEMENTATION. The Board ratifies all acts performed by the incorporators before this Resolution and directs the Corporate Secretary to deliver certified copies of this Resolution to banks, the registry, the National Tax Service, and external counsel. This Resolution shall be effective immediately and shall remain in force until rescinded by written resolution of the directors. ADOPTED this day by the unanimous written consent of all directors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Search, Articles of Incorporation, and Notarization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office licensed by the Korean Bar Association and the Court Name Availability Desk of the Supreme Court of Korea electronic registry.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Perform an online name-search through the Supreme Court of Korea electronic registry to confirm that the proposed name does not duplicate an existing Korean juristic person. Prepare Korean-language Articles of Incorporation in the Yuhan Hoesa format, stating the rail freight intermodal expedited freight forwarding business purpose, registered office, scope of members, number and value of membership interests, governance rules, and liquidation clause. All incorporators or their lawfully appointed attorneys must execute the Articles. Then notarize the Articles before a Korean notary public to produce a notarial deed of incorporation. For a non-resident member, a power of attorney with apostille or consular legalization is required. The notary will verify identity, signature, and capacity of each subscriber, after which the notarial deed is prepared in the official notarial form.
required_dossiers: Name-search certificate or printout
Draft Articles of Incorporation in Korean
Notarized power of attorney for foreign incorporators
Passport copies and corporate credentials of each incorporator
Individual seal or electronic seal registration certificate
Memorandum of address authorization for registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry notary rejects the name because it conflicts with an existing company, draft a new name and re-run the search. If the notary returns the Articles on technical defects, correct the defects and notarize a revised document within 3 business days. Any refusal of notarization may be remedied by appearing personally, curing signature authentication, or submitting a new apostilled power of attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Contribution and Escrow Deposit Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank authorized by the Financial Services Commission and the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit for anti-money-laundering and foreign-exchange verification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow deposit account in the name of the proposed company or in the promoter's name with a fully licensed banking institution. Complete customer due diligence, beneficial-ownership declarations, and source-of-funds forms, and instruct the bank to receive the full subscribed capital from each member's bank or remitting bank. After receipt of funds, obtain a Certificate of Capital Deposit naming the company, the account number, the deposit amount, the date, and the depositor; the certificate must be signed and sealed by the branch manager. For funds remitted from abroad, file the Foreign Exchange Transaction Report and obtain the bank's foreign capital receipt confirmation for later Foreign Investment Promotion Act registration.
required_dossiers: Application for temporary bank account opening
Beneficial ownership declaration and KYC questionnaire
Passport or corporate identification of each subscriber
Source-of-funds statement and bank account statements
Articles of Incorporation and name-search certificate
Foreign-exchange transaction report (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank suspends the account or requests further AML information, present the underlying rail logistics contracts, tax identification numbers, and notarized identity documents. If the source of funds remains unclear, provide certified recent bank statements and an affidavit of lawful funds. Should the bank decline, the company may apply to another commercial bank with a complete fresh documentation set and endeavor to obtain the certificate within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing Incorporation Registration at the District Court Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Civil Registry Division of the local District Court within the jurisdiction of the company's registered office, and the Supreme Court of Korea on-line registry platform for paperless filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 14 days after the capital deposit is completed, submit the application for registration of a Yuhan Hoesa to the District Court Registry. The application must be made on the official incorporation registration form, attaching the notarized Articles, the certificate of capital deposit, written consents from each appointed officer, the corporate seal report, the certificate of office address, and the identification documents of each officer. Payment of the registration license tax and the local education surcharge is calculated at approximately 0.4 percent of stated capital subject to the court's minimum tariff. If filed online, the applicant must verify the corporate identity with an accredited certificate and pay the fee through the e-registry payment channel. Upon successful examination, the registry will issue a certified corporate register extract, and the company materially becomes a legal person on the date of registration.
required_dossiers: Completed Yuhan Hoesa registration application form
Notarized deed of Articles of Incorporation
Certificate of Paid-in Capital Deposit
Written consent of each director to appointment
Corporate seal reporting form
Proof of registered office (lease agreement or owner consent)
Identification of each officer and beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a suspension notice or rejection due to missing notarization or deficient capital deposit certificate, the applicant may correct the defect and resubmit within 15 days. For substantive legal objections, file a correction request with the registry head and, if necessary, appeal to the competent district court within 30 days of receipt of the final rejection. Updated certifying documents must reflect the corrected registered office and officer appointments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: National Tax Service and Local Municipal Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Tax Service through the Hometax on-line portal and the local district tax office of the Seoul Regional Tax Authority or the municipality where the registered office is located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the corporate register extract is obtained, file the business registration application with the National Tax Service on the Hometax portal by selecting the corporate type and industrial classification for other transportation support activities. Include the corporate registration date, the corporate register certificate, registered office address, officer identification, business purpose, and bank account details. National Tax Service will assign a corporate business registration certificate and tax number; the certificate must be posted at the registered office and used for tax invoices. For VAT purposes, register the company as an ordinary corporate taxpayer. The company must also file a place-of-business tax registration with the local district government. If a non-resident shareholder made a capital remittance, the company and the shareholder must report the inward direct investment to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy or the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency through an authorized bank within 20 days to secure future dividend repatriation rights.
required_dossiers: Business registration application form for corporations
Certified copy of corporate register extract
Corporate Articles of Incorporation and seal certificate
Lease agreement and building ownership certificate
Passport and resident IDs of officers
Certificate of capital deposit and bank account confirmation
Foreign investment report (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the National Tax Service queries the industry classification or office address, file a correction statement explaining that the entity is a rail-freight intermodal expediting service under ISIC 5229 and provide amended lease documents. If processing is delayed, follow up through the Hometax electronic helpdesk and request written confirmation of acceptance. Non-response by the registry must be cured by escalating to the district tax office chief.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Sector Notification and Fire-Safety Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) Logistics Policy Division; Korea Railroad Corporation or licensed railway operator for service contracts; and the local Fire Station under the National Fire Agency for premise occupancy approval.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Because the authorized activity is rail freight intermodal expediting and freight forwarding rather than operation of railway rolling stock, no national freight-forwarder license is required solely for arranging rail transport. The company must, however, enter into an intermodal agency agreement or capacity allocation contract with a licensed railway operator such as Korea Railroad Corporation or Korea National Railway to purchase block-train capacity. If any domestic road freight brokerage is later added, a General Freight Brokerage Business License will be required from MOLIT under the Trucking Logistics Business Act. For the administrative office, apply at the local fire station for a Fire Safety Certificate for business premises, submit floor plans, and undertake an occupancy fire-safety inspection under the Fire Services Act. The company must also comply with the Occupational Safety and Health Act by appointing a workplace safety manager and ensuring basic fire extinguishers, exit signage, and electrical safety procedures are in place. For cross-border rail customs clearance, engage a licensed customs broker and register operational declarations through the Korea Customs Service UNI-PASS system.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation and business registration certificate
Corporate register extract
Registered office lease and fire inspection floor plan
Notarial Articles of Incorporation
Railway capacity agency contract with licensed operator
Appointment form of workplace safety manager
Customs broker service agreement and power of attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOLIT issues a notice that an unauthorized license is required because the company later expands into domestic road freight, apply for the appropriate freight broker license within 7 days or transfer that activity to a licensed third-party carrier. If the fire station rejects the certificate, correct the inspected violations and request a reinspection; appeals follow the Fire Services Act administrative appeal procedures. For customs irregularities, submit corrections through UNI-PASS and obtain a customs broker's written compliance certification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) Logistics Policy Division; Ministry of Environment; and the local Fire Station under the National Fire Agency for premises safety.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - No statutory manufacturing or sectoral operating license is mandated for pure rail-freight intermodal expedited freight forwarding. A General Freight Brokerage Business License becomes mandatory only if domestic road-freight brokerage is later added; railway block-train capacity must be contracted from a licensed railway operator.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of the Republic of Korea and delegated local environmental authorities, supported by the Korea Environment Corporation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Environmental Registration Only. The current non-manufacturing, non-construction, non-warehousing administrative and support activity under ISIC 5229 does not require a preliminary or full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA). A formal full EIA or Category B preliminary impact assessment is triggered only if the company later constructs or operates a physical container yard, transload depot, or warehouse exceeding the thresholds in the Environmental Impact Assessment Act Enforcement Decree.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: At present no discharge or emissions thresholds apply. If a physical logistics facility is developed, industrial wastewater must comply with the Water Environment Conservation Act, with BOD and suspended solids generally below 40 mg/L for standard industrial wastewater discharge; volatile organic compounds from any solvent or fuel handling must be controlled in accordance with the Clean Air Conservation Act, and hazardous waste must be manifested, tracked, and delivered only to licensed waste-treatment operators under the Waste Management Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The company must obtain a Fire Safety Certificate for Business Premises from the local fire station for its registered office, confirming acceptable fire exits, extinguishing equipment, electrical wiring, and occupancy load under the Fire Services Act. Civil Defense clearance is limited to the standard premises inspection because no chemical, explosive, or hazardous-material storage is involved. If a warehouse or intermodal terminal is later operated, a more detailed civil-defense fire-defense facility permit under the Fire Services Act and an occupational safety approval under the Occupational Safety and Health Act will become mandatory before operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service of the Republic of Korea (NTS); online electronic administration via HomeTax (hometax.go.kr); Korea Customs Service (KCS) via the UNI-PASS single window for customs clearance and export declaration processing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Korea-resident Yuhan Hoesa must first complete court registration under the Commercial Act, then file a business registration application with the local district tax office within 20 days after business commencement; the NTS will issue a 10-digit Business Registration Certificate number used simultaneously as the corporate tax identification number and the VAT identification number. For a foreign non-resident entity without a Korean place of business, the entity must appoint a Korean tax representative and submit a foreign business operator business registration application through HomeTax or the competent district tax office, attaching a certificate of incorporation or legal existence, articles of incorporation, a board resolution appointing the tax representative, and a power of attorney. The NTS issues a foreign business operator Business Registration Number in a separate series; the same number is used for electronic tax invoice issuance, VAT filings, and VAT refund claims. A foreign non-resident electronic-service supplier may complete the simplified registration procedure in HomeTax without a monetary threshold. Without registration, a foreign entity cannot issue zero-rated VAT invoices or recover input VAT and remains subject to Korean-source withholding taxes where applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Korean tax law does not provide a check-the-box election; a domestically incorporated Yuhan Hoesa is automatically a domestic corporation taxable at entity level on worldwide income. The only relevant group election is the consolidated corporate income tax filing election for wholly owned domestic parent and subsidiary groups, which does not alter individual entity classification. Korean hybrid mismatch rules under the Adjustment of International Taxes Act may apply separately.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold. Any person commencing a taxable Korean business must register within 20 days; registration is mandatory without regard to turnover. A foreign non-resident supplier of electronic services is obligated to register for Korean VAT when it begins supplying electronic services to Korean consumers, also without a monetary threshold. Simplified taxable person status is limited to qualifying individual sole proprietors whose annual VATable turnover does not exceed KRW 80,000,000 and is not available to Yuhan Hoesa as a corporation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Korea requires electronic tax invoicing for all corporate suppliers and for all tax invoices issued between registered VAT traders. Electronic tax invoices must be issued under the NTS HomeTax e-invoice system or using an NTS-certified electronic tax invoice API; data is transmitted to the NTS no later than the day after issuance and is cross-matched against the purchaser's VAT return. Korea does not operate a mandatory pre-clearance anti-fraud digital stamping system. For B2C supplies made by foreign electronic service providers using simplified registration, the NTS-administered reporting system is used in lieu of full electronic tax invoice issuance where required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods that are physically exported from Korea with an accepted Korea Customs Service export declaration, sold to a foreign purchaser, and settled in foreign exchange. Zero-rating also applies to exported services supplied to non-residents and paid in foreign currency where the place of supply is outside Korea, including international freight transport and international freight forwarding services such as transcontinental container block train and intermodal rail expeditions that carry cargo from Korea to foreign destinations. The supplier must issue a zero-rate electronic tax invoice and retain evidential title files showing the goods crossed the Korean border, the freight service was used outside Korea, and the foreign currency consideration was collected. Qualifying Korean supplies of digital services to non-residents may similarly be zero-rated if the export service and foreign exchange settlement conditions are met. If any condition is not met, the supply is subject to 10% Korean VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: KCS accepted Customs Export Declaration (export declaration or export manifest filed and confirmed through UNI-PASS)
Commercial invoice covering the exported containers and freight services
Negotiable Bill of Lading, multimodal transport bill, or CIM/SMGS rail waybill evidencing the intercontinental block train movement from Korea to the foreign destination
Packing list and container seal records for the rail intermodal shipment
Contract for freight forwarding/logistics services with the non-resident customer and, if used, the letter of credit
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) or foreign exchange bank settlement certificate evidencing actual collection of foreign currency proceeds
Korea Customs Service or NTS export performance certificate if required on audit
Copy of the zero-rated electronic tax invoice transmitted through HomeTax
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The NTS verifies zero-rated export claims by matching UNI-PASS customs declarations, HomeTax zero-rate e-invoice data, foreign exchange settlement records from banks, and the exporter's title documents. If foreign exchange proceeds are not collected within the applicable statutory settlement period, if the export declaration is rejected or matched to false documents, or if the supporting pack is incomplete, NTS will reverse the zero-rating, assess 10% VAT on the supply, impose statutory additional taxes for non-payment or fraudulent misdeclaration, claw back any input VAT already refunded, and charge daily late-payment interest. Fabricated export declarations, counterfeit FIRC certificates, or knowingly false e-invoices may additionally lead to criminal tax fraud penalties, Customs Act penalties, and director liability for the freight forwarder.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Korea (The Central Bank of the Republic of Korea) and the Foreign Exchange Information Network managed by the Ministry of Economy and Finance under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: South Korea operates a liberal but monitored foreign exchange system under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act. The Korean won is fully convertible for current account transactions, including cross-border freight invoices, operating expenses, and dividends, subject only to a post-transaction reporting obligation to the designated foreign exchange bank. Capital account transactions, such as equity injections by foreign shareholders and loan repayments, are subject to prior declaration or report, but standard inbound FDI is not restricted for entities in the freight and logistics sector. There is no surrender requirement for export earnings or service receipts; companies can retain foreign currency in designated accounts. The practical friction lies not in conversion itself but in the documentation and purpose-code validation required by the banks. For profit remittance abroad, the company must prove that corporate tax obligations have been settled by presenting a certificate of tax clearance, and the remittance must be declared under the appropriate purpose code. In emergency situations the authorities may impose temporary conversion limits, but such measures have not been active since the Asian Financial Crisis. Thus, for a rail freight forwarding entity, the treasury should expect routine monitoring rather than discretionary approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and its Enforcement Decree, export proceeds from rail freight and intermodal services must be received within the statutory settlement period (generally two years from exportation, unless extended). Upon receipt, the company must report the inflow to the appointed foreign exchange bank within 15 business days. There is no mandatory conversion of foreign currency into Korean won; the proceeds may be kept in a corporate foreign currency account (e.g., KRW, USD, EUR). If the proceeds remain outstanding beyond the settlement due date, the company must file a delayed receipt report and provide evidence of enforceable receivables. The term 'surrender' is not applied in Korea; effective controls are achieved via reporting thresholds and periodic banking supervision.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account for Foreign Investment
Trade Settlement Account for Freight Operations

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI platforms such as Wise, Revolut, Airwallex, or similar are legally disqualified from functioning as the primary banking counterparty for a Korean-domiciled limited liability company. The Banking Act of Korea restricts the acceptance of deposits and the issuance of trade-level outward payments to locally licensed banks. EMIs can only operate by piggybacking on a licensed Korean bank through wrapper cards or local partner accounts, but they cannot provide the essential documentary permissions (Foreign Exchange Information Network reporting, capital verification reports, or customs-related trade remittance processing). For a low-risk freight forwarding entity, an EMI can at most serve as an auxiliary low-value payment tool for refunds or micro-disbursements, but only after the primary treasury chain is kept within a tier-1 Korean bank. Overall viability: Very Limited - requires a sponsor bank, and should not be considered for FX hedging or regulatory compliance.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: All directors who are statutory representatives must appear physically at a branch of the chosen bank for the initial KYC interview and biometric verification. Remote opening via consular proxy is only permitted for extremely limited non-resident natural persons under special visa categories, but not for newly formed Korean LLCs where the director is a local resident or holds an Alien Registration Card. For foreign non-resident directors, Korean banks typically require the director to fly to Korea or appoint a local resident agent to co-sign bank documents and be named in the account mandate; document notarization and apostille are mandatory but do not waive the in-person visit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection from a non-resident shareholder to a newly established freight forwarding entity with no prior operating track record and low equity capital.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A certified copy of the shareholder's passport; bank reference letter and 12-month source-of-funds statements from the remitting bank; corporate registry extract; board resolution approving the capital contribution; proof of investment registration from the Ministry of Economy and Finance or a foreign investment registration form if applicable; a detailed business plan for the rail freight operations with projected cargo volumes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The freight forwarding business may engage shipment flows across or adjacent to high-risk or sanctioned territories (e.g., Eurasian transit corridors), causing the bank's sanctions screening system to generate false positives.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete sanctions screening matrix covering all counterparties and transit countries; attested end-user undertakings; validated bills of lading / CIM/SMGS rail consignment notes for sample shipments; a legal opinion from a Korean law firm confirming no restricted-party involvement; an internal compliance charter enumerating the screening steps and escalation procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between expected freight forwarding commission income and cash flow volumes, or frequent large-sum payments to freight carriers that look like third-party loan recycling (TBML).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Monthly commission ledger with matching underlying invoices; collection notices and proof of service completion; bank statements showing dedicated carriage settlement accounts; customs export/import declarations obtained from Korea Customs Service for the intermodal cargo; audited financial statements or CPA-compiled business statements covering the same period.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid multiple FX conversions and cross-border transfers between the Korean entity and overseas receiving parties in a short time, indicating potential layering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A transactional flow map explaining each wire's purpose; agreements with overseas freight agents; actual SWIFT MT103 copies of previous payments; a written protocol to identify high-risk geographies; transaction monitoring waiver request supported by the company's internal AML policy and training records.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The inbound equity subscription by non-resident investors must be routed through a local Capital Escrow Account at an authorized dealer bank. On the SWIFT wire, the remitter must include the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act purpose code corresponding to non-resident equity investment (e.g., 50110 under the Foreign Exchange Information Network) and note 'equity subscription of Korean LLC'. The receiving bank will match the funds to the corporate entity and issue a Capital Verification Report after the inward remittance is cleared. The Korean entity must submit an inward direct investment report to the Ministry of Economy and Finance (or delegated bank) within 30 days, attaching the entity's articles of incorporation, shareholder resolution, and a copy of the wire instruction. The inflow must not be netted against intra-group loans; it must pass as a clean wire. For subsequent liquidity, the company may open a separate Operating Currency Account and transfer funds from the escrow only after the formal capital verification is completed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For payment to third-party carriers, rail operators, and customs brokers, the company may use SWIFT MT103 direct wires for amounts below USD 50,000, subject to the bank's trade documentation review. For larger consolidated block-train settlements, a Commercial Letter of Credit opened at a Korean bank is recommended, especially when transacting with non-Korean suppliers, with documents made payable against presentation of transport documents (e.g., rail waybills). Alternatively, Documentary Collections (Documents against Payment, D/P) or Documents against Acceptance (D/A) can be used for recurring payments to trusted overseas logistics partners. All outbound disbursements must be linked to the underlying freight contract, commercial invoice, and transportation proof; the bank will require the appropriate settlement purpose code such as 'payments for transportation services' before effecting the wire. The settlement is cleared through the Korea Financial Telecommunications & Clearings Institute (KFTC) for domestic transfers and via SWIFT for international legs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forward contracts (KRW/USD and KRW/EUR) for committed freight receivables or carrier payables with a maximum maturity of 12 months, provided an underlying real transaction is demonstrated
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on KRW for non-resident funded legs, used when a separate offshore treasury entity needs to hedge against future tariff adjustments or intermodal fuel indices

Cross-currency interest rate or principal swaps between KRW and USD/EUR for funding cross-border operating leases of rail wagons and locomotives, subject to bank approval and underlying exposure testing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Base and Tax Amount Return (annual corporate income tax return) with annexed financial statements and schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) of the Republic of Korea via HomeTax electronic filing portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months from the fiscal year end; March 31 for a December 31 fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No-return penalty of 20% of the final corporate income tax payable or 0.5% of the gross taxable amount if no tax is payable; understatement penalty of 10% of the understated tax; delayed payment interest at the statutory daily rate currently 0.022% from the original due date; prolonged non-compliance permits NTS to conduct compulsory collection, seize assets, administratively close the business registration, and ultimately seek court-ordered dissolution of the Yuhan Hoesa.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Special Local Income Tax Corporate Return (corporate portion of local income tax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local government tax office of the business registration jurisdiction via the local government electronic tax system (WeTax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same deadline as the corporate income tax return; within 3 months from the fiscal year end; March 31 for a December 31 fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Additional local income tax delinquency surcharges mirror the national tax regime: 20% no-return penalty or 10% understatement penalty on the local corporate income tax due, plus statutory daily delayed interest; continued failure can trigger local tax seizure and forced collection measures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Status Report (applicable only if the Yuhan Hoesa is a registered foreign-invested company under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA) / Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy (MOTIE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 180 days after the fiscal year end; June 30 for a calendar-year company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of up to KRW 5 million for failure to file or for false reporting; serious or repeated non-compliance may cause the company to lose foreign-invested enterprise tax incentives and registration privileges, although it does not directly trigger automatic registry strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Independent External Audit Report Submission (required only when the entity meets statutory audit thresholds)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) via the electronic reporting system (DART)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 14 days after the external auditor signs and delivers the audit report; for a calendar-year audited company the report must be available for the annual members' meeting and corporate tax filing by March 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint an auditor or to submit the audit report may trigger fines under the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies, etc., against the company and its responsible officers; false or deficient audit reports are reported to the FSS and may result in regulatory sanctions, criminal referral, and disqualification of the auditor.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Members' General Meeting Approval of Financial Statements and Profit Appropriation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Statutory corporate records retained at the registered office; no government filing is required unless the company is subject to external audit designation by the FSS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after the end of each fiscal year; March 31 for a December 31 fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-convening is an internal governance defect that may invalidate profit distributions and can be raised by members, creditors, or tax authorities; for audited entities the FSS may impose administrative sanctions, but no automatic strike-off occurs solely for failure to hold the meeting.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the Act on External Audit of Stock Companies, etc. and its Enforcement Decree, an independent certified CPA audit is mandatory for a Yuhan Hoesa if any quantitative test is met at fiscal year end: (i) total assets equal or exceed KRW 12 billion (approximately USD 8.9 million); (ii) total assets equal or exceed KRW 10 billion (approximately USD 7.4 million) and the debt-to-equity ratio exceeds 300%; (iii) total assets equal or exceed KRW 7 billion (approximately USD 5.2 million) and the average number of employees exceeds 300; or (iv) the Financial Services Commission designates the company as a public-interest entity on the basis of size, turnover, or industry importance. Revenue alone does not mandate audit for a private Yuhan Hoesa unless the company is designated by the FSS.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Listed and audit-designated companies apply Korean International Financial Reporting Standards (K-IFRS). A private Yuhan Hoesa not listed and below the mandatory audit threshold may apply K-IFRS, Korean GAAP (K-GAAP), or the Simplified Accounting Standards for SMEs if it qualifies, with all statutory audits performed in accordance with Korean Standards on Auditing (KSA).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Republic of Korea does not require a separate annual UBO confirmation filing for a private Yuhan Hoesa. The company must maintain a continuous member register at its registered office, and any transfer of ownership becomes effective against the company and third parties only after the transferee is recorded in that register. If the registered ownership particulars or representative details change, a commercial registration amendment must be filed with the local District Court within 14 days. For a registered foreign-invested company, a shareholding transfer must be reported to KOTRA/MOTIE or the relevant reporting body within 30 days, and the investor must keep the foreign investment registration particulars accurate.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $4,000 – $15,000 per year if a mandatory external audit applies; no audit fee is required below the statutory threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24% for the 2025 Korean CIT rate schedule (plus a 10% local income tax surcharge, giving a combined marginal headline rate of 26.4%). The rate schedule is: 9% on taxable income up to KRW 200 million; 19% on KRW 200 million to KRW 20 billion; 21% on KRW 20 billion to KRW 300 billion; and 24% on taxable income above KRW 300 billion.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: General CIT incentives under the Restriction of Special Taxation Act: R&D tax credits for qualifying logistics IT and freight-forwarding technology; facility investment tax credits; employment and job creation credits; foreign-invested enterprise tax holidays available only for qualifying FDI projects approved in economic free zones or special foreign investment zones, typically 100% CIT exemption for 3 to 5 years and 50% reduction for the following 2 years; patent box is not separately available but qualifying self-developed patented technology licensing income can benefit from related R&D credits and tax-free reserves.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: 10 years for general companies and 15 years for SMEs under Korean Corporate Tax Law Article 13(1); loss carryforward is denied in certain merger or substantial shareholder change circumstances under the anti-fraud rules.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Korean Corporate Income Tax Return for Each Business Year (the principal NTS corporate return combining the income statement, tax adjustments, taxable income calculation and final tax computation) filed through the National Tax Service HomeTax electronic platform. Non-resident corporations without a Korean permanent establishment use the Non-Resident Corporation Korean-Source Income Withholding Return through the same HomeTax portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing for each fiscal year; a semi-annual provisional CIT return is required within two months after the expiry of the first six months of the fiscal year; quarterly installment payments apply to large corporations; non-resident withholding filings are monthly and due by the 10th day of the following month.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a 31 December fiscal year-end, the annual CIT return and final tax payment are due by 31 March of the following year. If the financial statements are certified by an external tax accountant, the deadline may be extended by one month; further extension to the end of the fourth month may be granted with NTS approval. The semi-annual provisional return for a calendar-year company is due by 31 August.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification and foreign investment declaration: business registration number, legal entity name, representative director, registered address, business sites, fiscal year, and whether the company is a foreign-invested enterprise under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the full chain of non-resident beneficial owners and any intermediate holding companies. If a non-resident owns more than 10% of Yuhan Hoesa or the investment exceeds KRW 100 million, the foreign-invested enterprise indicator must be completed; failure to do so can block treaty benefits, DTA relief, and lawful profit repatriation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue: sales of freight forwarding services, transcontinental container block train expediting, intermodal haulage, customs clearance coordination, terminal handling, documentation fees, and incidental logistics income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Korea taxes worldwide income of a domestically managed company. For the EURASIA rail block-train activity, do not exclude revenue simply because the trains traverse China, Kazakhstan, Russia, or Europe; allocation is unnecessary if the Korean entity is the contractual freight forwarder and the enterprise is resident in Korea. If a foreign railway operator uses Yuhan Hoesa as a dependent commission agent, that foreign operator may have a Korean permanent establishment; conversely, if Yuhan Hoesa is compensated on behalf of a foreign principal, the agency fee should be supported by a written contract and OECD Article 8 transport-profit analysis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales: rail haulage purchased from railway operators, container positioning and leasing costs, line-haul tariffs, transshipment terminal costs, customs broker fees, security and escort costs, insurance, and direct personnel costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to related-party railway operators and logistics suppliers must be priced at arm's length and supported by contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation. If the Korean payer settles a fee to a non-resident supplier without a valid contract, without proof of actual service, or without Korean withholding tax processing for Korean-source royalty or service income, the cost may be disallowed as a deduction and the withholding agent liability will be imposed on the local director.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling, general, and administrative expenses: payroll, rent, office expenses, communication, sales commissions, outbound and inbound marketing, vehicle and equipment costs, IT systems, and legal/professional fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For allocation of headquarters or foreign affiliate expenses to a Korean related company, the expenditure must be actually incurred, supported by an intercompany service agreement, and invoiced at cost plus an arm's-length margin. The Korean permanent-establishment net-basis filing should not deduct fees that merely shift profits out of Korea without economic substance. Maintain time sheets, delivery records, and subcontracted expense vouchers to prove that the CIGA for the freight forwarding business occurs in Korea.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating income: interest income, foreign exchange gains, dividend income from subsidiaries, gains on disposal of fixed assets, reversal of allowances, and other miscellaneous income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received from non-resident subsidiaries may qualify for the 95% intercorporate dividend deduction only if the Korean parent has held at least 10% for more than 18 months, but the rules are non-automatic and require documentation of the holding period and underlying corporate tax payment. If Yuhan Hoesa receives interest from a Korean borrower, the interest is subject to 22% withholding; report that withholding in the prepayment credit box. Foreign exchange gains and losses from EURASIA freight invoices invoiced in USD, CNY, or EUR must be realized or marked-to-model according to Korean GAAP and NTS guidance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating expenses: interest expense, foreign exchange losses, donations, impairment losses, and losses on disposal of assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to a non-resident shareholder or affiliate is subject to South Korea's thin-capitalization rule: interest on related-party debt exceeding a 2:1 debt-to-equity ratio is denied. Ensure the interest rate, debt instrument, and beneficial owner are separately documented. Cross-border related-party interest is also subject to the 22% statutory withholding tax, or 15% under an applicable tax treaty only after the treaty-benefit application has been filed. Donations made to foreign nonprofit entities are generally not deductible unless specifically listed in the Restriction of Special Taxation Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax adjustments: income additions (disallowed expenses, non-deductible entertainment, officer compensation in excess of limits, tax penalties), income deductions (allowable reserves, tax-free income, prior-year corrections), and loss carryforward deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident related-party transactions must be adjusted to the arm's-length standard under the International Tax Adjustment Act: unacceptable markups on rail services or inflated management fees from the overseas parent are reclassified as constructive dividends or deemed payments. A claim of treaty protection for the income has no effect on the Korean entity's obligation to file a correct return; unsubstantiated foreign tax credits are rejected. Loss carryforwards cannot exceed the statutory carryforward period and may be forfeited if a change in 50% or more of the shares substantially changes the business purpose.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation and credits: application of the progressive CIT rate, alternative minimum tax, local income tax surcharge, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, employment tax credit, prepaid corporate tax, interim tax paid, earlier installments, and withholding tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If Yuhan Hoesa has paid foreign withholding taxes on EURASIA rail fees or terminal usage fees in third countries, the foreign tax credit must be claimed within the statutory five-year carryforward period and supported by certificates issued by the foreign tax authority. Credits cannot exceed the Korean tax attributable to the relevant foreign-source income. Any tax withheld at source in Korea on interest or dividend income received by Yuhan Hoesa is credited in this box and must be reconciled with monthly withholding statements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax payable or refund: aggregate of Box 7 and 8 computations, calculation of advanced payments, distribution of the remaining balance, and self-assessment signature of the representative director and the tax preparer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a Korean resident LLC paying a dividend to a non-resident shareholder, the final CIT balance paid here is separate from the 22% shareholder dividend withholding tax; the company acts as withholding agent and pays the dividend WHT to the NTS before remitting the net dividend. Never net the shareholder-level dividend WHT against the entity-level CIT liability. Incorrect self-assessment here triggers non-filing, under-reporting, and late-payment surcharges.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or failure to pay the principal CIT results in: (i) non-filing surtax of 20% of the unpaid tax (or 40% for fraudulently omitted returns); (ii) under-reporting surtax of 10% of the understated amount (or 40% for fraudulent understatement); (iii) daily late-payment surcharge of 0.022% on the unpaid amount from the statutory due date until settlement, plus a fixed 3% negligence penalty for non-payment; and (iv) criminal liability under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act for intentional evasion, punishable by imprisonment of up to 3 years (up to 5 years for repeat offenders) or a fine of up to twice the evaded tax. The NTS may also impose director travel bans, seizure of personal assets on piercing the corporate veil, and public blacklisting as a serious habitual tax delinquent.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 22% outbound dividend withholding tax for a Korean corporation paying dividends to a non-resident shareholder, composed of 20% national corporate withholding under the Corporate Tax Law plus a 2% local income tax surcharge. The domestic rate is reduced by an applicable bilateral double tax treaty, normally to 15% for portfolio dividends and to 5% for a corporate shareholder owning at least 25% of the voting shares for a continuous holding period of not less than six months (subject to specific treaty wording). If the beneficial owner qualifies as a foreign government or treaty-protected institution, a complete exemption can apply under selected treaties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim DTA relief, the non-resident recipient and the Korean withholding agent must file the Korean application form for exemption or reduction of withholding tax on foreign corporation Korean-source income through HomeTax before remitting the dividend, interest, or royalty. The applicant must submit: (i) a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the competent tax authority of the treaty jurisdiction for the year in which the income is paid; (ii) a beneficial-ownership declaration identifying the ultimate natural persons or listed corporations; (iii) evidence that the shareholder holds 25% or more of Yuhan Hoesa for the relevant treaty period when the lower holding-based dividend rate is claimed; and (iv) supporting economic-substance proof such as payroll, office lease, freight-forwarding contracts, board minutes, and invoice records demonstrating that the recipient performs core income-generating activities in its residence state. The Korean payer must then deliver the approved application to the NTS on or before the monthly withholding return due date; otherwise the statutory 22% rate must be withheld, and a refund is generally allowed only through a corrective return or administrative appeal if the treaty benefit is proven later.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate for cross-border royalties and interest paid by a Korean resident company to a non-resident affiliate: 22% (20% national withholding plus 2% local income tax surcharge). Treaty rates vary by country: Korean bilateral DTAs typically reduce interest to 15%, with 0% or 5% for certain financial institutions, export credit agencies, and government bodies; royalties are generally reduced to 15%, with a lower 10% or 5% rate for equipment royalties, copyright royalties on literary or artistic works, or industrial royalties in selected treaties. The reduced rates apply only if the recipient is the beneficial owner, files the treaty-relief application, and complies with any limitation-on-benefits provision, including the principal-purpose test under the Multilateral Instrument for jurisdictions with synthetic or mailbox holding companies.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: KRW 5,000,000,000 (approx. USD 4.2 million) per category of related-party transactions in a fiscal year triggers the preparation and submission of the Korean Local File; KRW 100,000,000,000 of total revenue triggers the Korean Master File; KRW 500,000,000 per category of related
